0.text: Best be on your way peasant, there are nobler than you traveling the roads. Be sure to keep to the side when the wagons pass.

1.text: Oh your still here, what are you lost?

0.text: Oh another lost adventurer from some small village thought to make it big in the city. Very well I suppose you are looking for University Isle. you must cross the wooden bridge before us.

1.text: Then turn right head across a stone bridge with our guard stations on it. Finally take another right across the stone bridge of the Brotherhood.

2.text: There rising above the clouds stands the University of the Traveling Brotherhood of Science.

0.text: Right, if you are looking for the market, cross the bridge and head towards the city, it's in the northeast corner of the square.
